note: Hand-filled list of Dubai family outings, used for the outings planner. Ticket prices are estimates typed in on the date above from memory, not checked on the venues' sites (verify before recording the demo). The app always says these are saved prices and asks the family to check the price on the site before booking. Travel, parking, food and extras are not included.

outings.name: Kite Beach
outings.about: Free beach with a running track, playgrounds and a view of the Burj Al Arab. Bring water and snacks from home.

outings.name: Dubai Fountain show
outings.about: The fountain show by the Burj Khalifa, every evening. Free to watch from the promenade.

outings.name: Al Qudra Lakes picnic
outings.about: Desert lakes with birds and sunset views. Free; take a picnic. It is a drive out, so fuel is extra.

outings.name: Mohammed Bin Rashid Library
outings.about: A big library with a children's floor and reading corners, free to visit. Good on a hot day.

outings.name: Quranic Park gardens
outings.about: Gardens with plants named in the Quran and an open-air play area. The gardens are free; the cave and glasshouse cost extra.

outings.name: Ripe Market weekend market
outings.about: A weekend market with music and kids' corners. Free to walk in; set a small amount for snacks before you go.

outings.name: Abra ride on Dubai Creek
outings.about: Cross the creek on a wooden abra boat, then walk through Al Seef and the old souks.

outings.name: Zabeel Park picnic
outings.about: A large park with playgrounds, a lake and space for a picnic and a ball game.

outings.name: Al Mamzar Beach Park
outings.about: Calm beaches, lawns and playgrounds in one park. Good for younger kids.

outings.name: Al Shindagha Museum
outings.about: The story of Dubai and the creek, with hands-on rooms. Next to the abra stations.

outings.name: Etihad Museum
outings.about: How the UAE came together, with films and games. Indoors and cool.

outings.name: Global Village
outings.about: Pavilions from around the world, shows and food. The weekday online ticket is the cheapest; rides and food cost extra.

outings.name: Dubai Safari Park
outings.about: Animals from Africa and Asia in big open areas. The basic explorer ticket is enough for a family day.

outings.name: Dubai Frame
outings.about: A glass bridge 150 metres up, with old Dubai on one side and new Dubai on the other.

outings.name: Dubai Miracle Garden
outings.about: Millions of flowers shaped into castles, planes and animals. Open in the cooler months only.

outings.name: The Green Planet
outings.about: An indoor rainforest with sloths, birds and fish. A treat rather than a weekly outing.
